<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Yuliana Putri Handayani -- Social Media Manager &amp; VA</title>
<meta name="description" content="Social Media Manager, Graphic Designer, and Bookkeeping &amp; Admin VA based in Bekasi, Indonesia. Open for remote work.">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --bg:#F0E7D3; --bg2:#D0DDCB; --green:#4E6813; --yellow:#FFEDA8;
    --lav:#B0A6DF; --red:#74070E; --dark:#1C1A14; --mid:#4A4540;
    --muted:#7A746E; --white:#FFFFFF; --border:rgba(78,104,19,0.15);
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--dark); min-height:100vh; overflow-x:hidden; position:relative; }

  .deco { position:fixed; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
  .deco-tl { top:-20px; left:-20px; width:260px; opacity:0.1; }
  .deco-br { bottom:-20px; right:-20px; width:300px; opacity:0.09; transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .deco-mid { top:45%; right:-15px; width:140px; opacity:0.06; }

  .page { position:relative; z-index:1; max-width:480px; margin:0 auto; padding:3rem 1.5rem 5rem; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }

  .photo-wrap { position:relative; margin-bottom:1.5rem; animation:fadeUp 0.7s ease both; }
  .photo-ring {
    width:112px; height:112px; border-radius:50%; overflow:hidden;
    border:3px solid var(--green);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--bg), 0 0 0 7px rgba(78,104,19,0.18), 0 10px 36px rgba(78,104,19,0.18);
    background:var(--white);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .photo-ring img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .status-dot { position:absolute; bottom:6px; right:6px; width:17px; height:17px; background:#22c55e; border-radius:50%; border:2.5px solid var(--bg); animation:pulse-green 2.5s ease infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse-green { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0.45)} 60%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0)} }

  .name { font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1.85rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--dark); text-align:center; line-height:1.15; margin-bottom:0.3rem; animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.08s ease both; }
  .name em { color:var(--green); font-style:italic; }
  .handle { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:1.1rem; animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.12s ease both; }

  .roles { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:7px; margin-bottom:1rem; animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.17s ease both; }
  .role-pill { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:500; padding:5px 14px; border-radius:30px; border:1px solid transparent; }
  .rp-green { background:rgba(78,104,19,0.1); color:var(--green); border-color:rgba(78,104,19,0.2); }
  .rp-lav { background:rgba(176,166,223,0.2); color:#3C3489; border-color:rgba(176,166,223,0.35); }
  .rp-yellow { background:rgba(255,237,168,0.6); color:#7A5F00; border-color:rgba(255,200,0,0.25); }
  .role-pill svg { width:13px; height:13px; flex-shrink:0; }

  .open-badge { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--green); color:var(--yellow); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:500; padding:7px 20px; border-radius:30px; margin-bottom:2rem; animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.22s ease both; }
  .open-dot { width:7px; height:7px; background:#86efac; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; animation:pulse-green 2s ease infinite; }

  .prolog-card { width:100%; background:var(--white); border-radius:20px; padding:1.6rem 1.8rem; border:1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(78,104,19,0.07); animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.27s ease both; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .prolog-card::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:4px; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--green), var(--lav)); }
  .prolog-eyebrow { font-size:9.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:0.85rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding-left:14px; }
  .prolog-eyebrow::after { content:''; flex:1; height:1px; background:var(--border); }
  .prolog-text { font-size:13.5px; color:var(--mid); line-height:1.9; font-weight:300; padding-left:14px; }
  .prolog-text strong { color:var(--green); font-weight:600; }
  .prolog-text .greeting { font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--dark); font-weight:600; display:block; margin-bottom:0.9rem; }
  .prolog-text p { margin-bottom:0.85rem; }
  .prolog-text p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }

  .pitch-strip { width:100%; background:var(--bg2); border-radius:16px; padding:1.1rem 1.5rem; margin-bottom:2rem; border:1px solid rgba(78,104,19,0.12); text-align:center; animation:fadeUp 0.7s 0.32s ease both; }
  .pitch-text { font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--green); line-height:1.5; font-style:italic; }

  .sec-lbl { width:100%; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:0.7rem; padding-left:2px; }

  .links-group { width:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; margin-bottom:2rem; }
  .link-card { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px; padding:13px 16px; border-radius:16px; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease; }
  .link-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(78,104,19,0.15); }
  .link-card:active { transform:scale(0.98); }
  .lc-main { background:var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); animation:fadeUp 0.5s 0.35s ease both; }
  .lc-lav { background:rgba(176,166,223,0.18); border:1px solid rgba(176,166,223,0.32); animation:fadeUp 0.5s 0.41s ease both; }
  .lc-wa { background:#f0faf3; border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.22); animation:fadeUp 0.5s 0.47s ease both; }
  .card-icon-wrap { width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:11px; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .lc-main .card-icon-wrap { background:rgba(255,237,168,0.15); }
  .lc-lav .card-icon-wrap { background:rgba(176,166,223,0.3); }
  .lc-wa .card-icon-wrap { background:rgba(34,197,94,0.12); }
  .card-icon-wrap svg { width:19px; height:19px; }
  .card-txt { flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .ct-title { font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.25; margin-bottom:2px; }
  .lc-main .ct-title { color:var(--yellow); }
  .lc-lav .ct-title { color:#2A2460; }
  .lc-wa .ct-title { color:#166534; }
  .ct-sub { font-size:11px; opacity:0.65; line-height:1.35; }
  .lc-main .ct-sub { color:var(--yellow); }
  .lc-lav .ct-sub { color:#3C3489; }
  .lc-wa .ct-sub { color:#166534; }
  .card-arrow { font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0; opacity:0.4; transition:transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s; }
  .lc-main .card-arrow { color:var(--yellow); }
  .lc-lav .card-arrow { color:#3C3489; }
  .lc-wa .card-arrow { color:#166534; }
  .link-card:hover .card-arrow { opacity:1; transform:translateX(3px); }

  .divider { width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:1.75rem; }
  .div-line { flex:1; height:1px; background:var(--border); }

  .cta-box { width:100%; background:var(--yellow); border-radius:20px; padding:1.75rem 1.8rem; text-align:center; margin-bottom:2.5rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,200,0,0.25); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(255,200,0,0.12); animation:fadeUp 0.5s 0.52s ease both; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .cta-box::after { content:''; position:absolute; bottom:-30px; right:-30px; width:120px; height:120px; background:rgba(78,104,19,0.05); border-radius:50%; }
  .cta-headline { font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--green); line-height:1.45; margin-bottom:0.7rem; }
  .cta-sub { font-size:12.5px; color:var(--mid); line-height:1.75; margin-bottom:1.1rem; }
  .cta-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; background:var(--green); color:var(--yellow); font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; padding:10px 24px; border-radius:30px; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .cta-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(78,104,19,0.28); }

  .footer { text-align:center; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.9; animation:fadeUp 0.5s 0.6s ease both; }
  .footer strong { color:var(--green); font-weight:600; }
  .footer-dot { width:28px; height:2px; background:var(--bg2); border-radius:2px; margin:0.65rem auto; }

  @keyframes fadeUp { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
  @media(max-width:420px) { .page{padding:2.5rem 1.25rem 4rem} .name{font-size:1.55rem} }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- BOTANICAL DECO TOP LEFT -->
<svg class="deco deco-tl" viewBox="0 0 260 260" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <!-- LOGO AS PROFILE PHOTO -->

      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="YPH Logo - Yuliana Putri Handayani Virtual Assistant">

  <!-- NAME -->
  <h1 class="name">Yuliana <em>Putri</em> Handayani</h1>

    </span>

  <!-- ABOUT ME -->
  <div class="prolog-card">

      <p class="prolog-text" style="padding-left:14px;">
        I'm a Social Media Manager with a strong sense of responsibility, professionalism, and integrity. With over 8 years of experience in accounting roles, I bring <strong>corporate-level discipline</strong> into my work as a Virtual Assistant.

      <br>
      <p class="prolog-text" style="padding-left:14px;">
        I support content planning, scheduling, and daily social media operations with a structured and organized approach while ensuring <strong>consistency, timely execution</strong>, and alignment with your brand voice and business goals.
      </p>
      <br>

        I started my VA journey in 2025, supporting entrepreneurs and business owners through social media management and light bookkeeping. My goal is to provide <strong>reliable and high quality support</strong>, so you stay focused on the bigger picture while I handle the details behind the scenes.

  </div>

  <!-- MY WORK -->
  <p class="sec-lbl">My Work</p>
  <div class="links-group">

      <div class="card-icon-wrap">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#FFEDA8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="3" width="20" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/></svg>

  <!-- CONNECT -->
  <p class="sec-lbl">Connect With Me</p>
